character_types: man in drag as a curly-haired woman
key_props: coffee cups and plate of pastries
visual_synopsis: Two women sit in patterned armchairs over coffee and pastries in a living room, gossiping at length; one of them is plainly a male actor in a curly ginger wig with blue eyeshadow and red lipstick. Their conversation is repeatedly intercut with a moustached man in a white shirt covered in red spots, standing by a window and ranting while pulling his collar aside to show scratch marks on his shoulder.
